latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.21
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.21

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.21. All three engine families (`strata-engine`, `strata-inkling` and `strata-hy4`) and Control are updated to 0.1.67 on every supported platform and backend.

## What changes for you

- **Inkling 2 Mini is much faster on most cards.** Compared with 0.2.20 on the same machines:
  - **Long conversations:**
    - RTX 4090 after a 32K prompt: 92 instead of 29 tok/s (UD-Q4_K_XL) and 92 instead of 20 tok/s (SQ-20).
    - RTX 5090 Laptop 24 GB after a 30K prompt: 72 instead of 44 tok/s.
  - **Smaller cards:**
    - RTX 3060 Ti 8 GB, SQ-10: 43 instead of 11 tok/s.
    - RTX 5070 12 GB, SQ-10: 68 instead of 12.5 tok/s.
  - **Prompt reading:**
    - RTX 5090: 6,967 instead of 3,923 tok/s (UD-Q4_K_XL), 9,019 instead of 7,568 tok/s (SQ-20).
    - DGX Spark: +12% to +58%.
  - **Many users at once:**
    - RTX 5090 with 64 requests: 1,040–1,134 tok/s in total, 6–27% above 0.2.20.
    - 8 users: 15–27% faster on the RTX 4090, the RTX 5090 and the RTX 5090 Laptop.
  - **AMD RX 7900 XT, UD-IQ3_XXS:** 66 instead of 4.9 tok/s.
- **Agent sessions reuse their prompt** on every backend, Apple Silicon included. Long agent sessions no longer re-read the whole prompt on every turn.
- **The DSpark drafter works with Unsloth's re-uploaded GGUF model files.** 0.2.20 could not start UD models with the drafter on. Unsloth's new separate drafter file (`dspark-Inkling-2-Mini-Q8_0.gguf`, uploaded 23 November) is not read yet; Strata's own drafter download is not affected.
  - A single request is now sent to the slot the drafter runs in, so it gets the drafter's speed even with 2 to 4 slots. On an RTX 5090 Laptop with 2 to 3 slots: agent sessions 85 → 142–152 tok/s, chat 87 → 120 tok/s.
  - When the request lands in that slot, code is about 2x and chat about 1.4x faster.
  - At startup a short test decides whether the drafter is turned on for your card. The first start of a new setup takes about 3 minutes longer because of it.
- **Fixes:**
  - long-conversation crash (#6905);
  - Qwen "layer 0 never rang" on RTX 30-series and newer (#6713);
  - repeated engine crashes now stop after three tries with a clear message instead of restarting forever;
  - downloads are pinned so Unsloth re-uploads no longer break setup, and both GGUF layouts are accepted;
  - Inkling on CPUs with AVX-512 has a faster path, and AVX2-only CPUs keep working.
- **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and HY-4 Flash:**
  - **Qwen:** one accuracy fix in prompt reading (#6776). It changes the order of one sum, so some answers can differ from 0.2.20 after a few tokens; the first-token choice was the same on every prompt we checked, and speed is the same.
  - **HY-4 Flash:** gives the same output as 0.2.20 in our checks on Strix Halo and on CPU.

## Known limits

- **Default slots:** on 24 GB RTX 40 / 50 cards the app now starts with 1 slot, which gives the best speed for one person and for long documents. You can raise it in the app.
- **32 slots is for short requests.** With long prompts (3K tokens and up) at 32 slots, each long request can wait several minutes for its first token. On cards up to 24 GB, and on the RTX 5090 at 64K context, a 32-slot start can fail to load. For long documents use 8 slots or fewer.
- **AMD RX 7900 XT / 7900 XTX with SQ-20:** decode is about 7% below 0.2.20. Workaround: `--vram-experts-gb 13.2 --ram-experts-gb 2.5`.
- **AMD 12 GB cards (RX 6700 XT class), Inkling:** about 13% below 0.2.20. Workaround: `--vram-experts-gb 8.5`.
- **Many slots:** with 16 or more slots on NVIDIA, the first reply after a long prompt is slightly less exact than with fewer slots. This was already the case in 0.2.20.

## Updating

- **App:** the in-app update offers 0.2.21, or download the installer below.
- **Terminal:** run `strata update`.
- **A clone of the repository:** run `UPDATE.bat` (Windows) or `./setup.sh --update`.

## Downloads

Total: 64 files, 13,380,684,413 bytes.

All `strata-engine`, `strata-inkling`, and `strata-hy4` 0.1.67 packages ar

[Engine] Turing (sm_75): make the STRATA_SM75_PERF series the default, with expert mode 8 for i-quant packs
[Engine] 0.1.60 prompt kernels: -13% at 20,000 tokens on a 16 GB card, +8% at 40,000, flat at 16,000
[Engine] Layer-major prefill on a CUDA layer split: 32K prompts 2.0x faster, 0.47x drive reads (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, v0.2.4.2)
[Engine] Intel Arc Pro B70 (SYCL): output corrupts to "!!!!" as prompts get longer, with drafting on or off
[Engine] RX 7900 XTX (gfx1100) machine restarts under Strata serving (follow-up to #872)
[Engine] Qwen3.8 Flash-Next on two mixed NVIDIA cards (RTX 4090 24 GB + RTX 4080 16 GB)?

Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Tencent Hy4-Flash | Pack | Your RAM | Graphics card | | --- | --- | --- | | **SQ-64** | 64 GiB | 8, 12 or 16 GiB | | **SQ-96** | 96 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | | **SQ-128** | 128 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | The number in the name is the RAM the pack is made for. [Hy4-Flash packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Hy4-Flash-Strata)
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
 Inkling 2 Mini | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **Strata** | SQ-20 (19.35 GB), SQ-15 (14.35 GB), SQ-10 (10.47 GB) | | **Unsloth** | UD-Q8\_K\_XL (22.87 GB), UD-Q4\_K\_XL (17.63 GB), UD-Q4\_K\_M (16.61 GB), UD-IQ4\_XS (15.73 GB), UD-Q3\_K\_XL (13.63 GB), UD-IQ3\_XXS (11.66 GB), UD-Q2\_K\_XL (9.14 GB), UD-IQ2\_XXS (8.49 GB), UD-IQ1\_M (8.02 GB), UD-IQ1\_S (7.76 GB) | SQ-20 is made for a 24 GiB graphics card, SQ-15 for 16 GiB and SQ-10 for 12 GiB. A 4 GiB card is enough to start. [Strata packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata) · [Unsloth GGUF files](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF)
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.21-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.21-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.21-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.
